description: This Perl module defines the class Git::SVN::Ra which is a wrapper around SVN::Ra for use by git-svn. It implements SVN remote access functions with caching, version compatibility adjustments, and additional logic specific to git-svn. The file includes methods for repository interaction such as get_dir, get_log, do_switch, and other SVN operations, as well as internal setup and configuration handling.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Ra
classes.description: A wrapper class for SVN::Ra providing additional functionality, caching, and version compatibility for git-svn.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new Git::SVN::Ra object for the given URL, canonicalizing the URL, setting up authentication and configuration.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Getter/setter for the repository URL, ensuring it is canonicalized.

methods.name: check_path
methods.description: Checks if a path exists at a given revision, using cache to optimize repeated calls.

methods.name: get_dir
methods.description: Retrieves directory entries at a specified path and revision, with caching and compatibility handling.

methods.name: get_log
methods.description: Retrieves log entries between revisions, with path prefix adjustments and support for limits.

methods.name: trees_match
methods.description: Compares two URLs and revisions for tree differences, used for legacy SVN version compatibility.

methods.name: get_commit_editor
methods.description: Returns a commit editor, adjusting for SVN version differences.

methods.name: gs_do_update
methods.description: Performs an update operation on a git-svn working copy, managing the SVN reporter and editor.

methods.name: gs_do_switch
methods.description: Performs an SVN switch operation, handling reparenting if necessary.

methods.name: longest_common_path
methods.description: Calculates the longest common directory path among given git-svn glob objects.

methods.name: gs_fetch_loop_common
methods.description: Main loop to fetch SVN logs in chunks, updating git-svn indexes accordingly.

methods.name: get_dir_globbed
methods.description: Recursively gets directory listings up to a specified depth, used in glob expansion.

methods.name: minimize_url
methods.description: Attempts to shorten a given repository URL by removing components while keeping the URL valid.

methods.name: can_do_switch
methods.description: Checks if the SVN reparent (switch) operation is supported with the current SVN version.

methods.name: skip_unknown_revs
methods.description: Handles SVN error codes related to missing revisions or repositories, filtering known errors.

methods.name: is_ref_ignored
methods.description: Determines if a reference should be ignored based on ignore_ref regexes.

methods.name: match_globs
methods.description: Matches directory globs against SVN directory entries, expanding globs and handling ignored refs.
